description: Checks WNTR simulator selection and controlled WDN scenario comparisons.

evals.label: Select simulator from requested analysis
evals.prompt: The task requires a WNTR leak scenario and water-quality outputs. Explain the simulator and capability checks needed before running.
evals.expected_output: The agent distinguishes WNTRSimulator leak support from EpanetSimulator water-quality support and identifies the feature conflict rather than claiming one simulator supports both without checking.
assertions: The response distinguishes simulator capabilities and limitations.
The response asks the user to choose or split the analysis if the requested capabilities do not coexist.

evals.label: Keep baseline and scenario runs comparable
evals.prompt: Compare a baseline WNTR run with a pump-outage scenario after the same WaterNetworkModel object has already been modified by another scenario.
evals.expected_output: The agent warns that model state may carry over and recommends reloading or resetting a clean baseline before comparison.
assertions: The response requires clean equivalent initial conditions for the comparison.
The response does not invent pump status, demands, or acceptance thresholds.

evals.label: Route parser-only validation to epanet-validation
evals.prompt: Check whether this EPANET INP file has parser/structural errors with epanetparser; do not run a hydraulic scenario.
evals.expected_output: The captured text signals epanet-validation for native parser/static checks rather than WNTR analysis/design workflows.
